changes: New: 'Place an Offer' tool replaces the standalone 'Repair Quote' bottom-nav slot. Single-page form (client/src/components/ld/WriteOfferSheet.tsx) mirroring Alex's 'AAA WRITE AN OFFER' text template — FUB contact picker + separate Full Legal Name field for up to 2 buyers, financing type/lender selectors, purchase price with computed binder deposit / down payment / seller agent comp dollar amounts, offer-expiration day+time computed to an actual date, assignment and home-sale-contingency toggles, additional terms textarea, and a static docs-to-include list. On submit, POSTs to /api/write-offer which emails the composed offer to the TC (whittney@nextlevelfl.com) with nate@ and alex@ CC'd.

The standalone Repair Consult flow (Tab id 'repairQuote', its render block, and the Lead Gen radial 'Repairs' edge bubble) is left fully intact — only the bottom NAV array entry was swapped from Repair Quote to Place an Offer, per Alex's explicit instruction to swap the button, not remove the flow.

New backend module server/writeOffer.ts (registerWriteOfferRoutes) exposing POST /api/write-offer (composes + sends the branded offer email) and GET /api/write-offer/lenders (lender presets + TC contact info), registered in server/routes.ts alongside the existing repairConsult/listingConsult/fubContacts route registrations.

Carried forward from the prior uncommitted session (shipping together in this release): ListingConsultSheet gallery UI on the preview step, FUB contact picker on the prep step, Lock In phone/email auto-default, and heroPhotoUrl hand-off into the nested Repair Consult (nestedFromListing + prefillHeroPhotoUrl props on RepairConsultSheet).
__bundleNotes: No bundleMustNotContain guards: Repair Quote / repairQuote intentionally remain present elsewhere (standalone flow + radial bubble untouched), so a global-absence check on that string would false-positive.
